scene_context.physical_setting: Domestic interior: Bedroom, hallway, and home office of a suburban house.
scene_context.social_context: Dyadic marital conflict (interrupted briefly by child)

characters.physical_description: Adult female, blonde wavy hair, light blue button-down shirt.

initial_state.body_language_summary: Upright posture, direct gaze, pursuing the male character.
initial_state.apparent_goal: To extract truthful information regarding finances.
behavioral_evidence: Following the male into the room

final_state.body_language_summary: Shoulders slumped, turning away, walking out of room.
final_state.apparent_goal: To withdraw from social obligation (the party).

characters.physical_description: Adult male, dark hair, green plaid shirt.

initial_state.body_language_summary: Seated behind desk (barrier), avoiding eye contact, defensive hand gestures.
initial_state.apparent_goal: To minimize the conflict and hide the extent of financial trouble.

final_state.body_language_summary: Standing ground, rigid posture, shouting after the female.
final_state.apparent_goal: To assert control over the upcoming social event (party).

characters.physical_description: Young girl, light dress, sitting at keyboard.

behavioral_evidence: Not looking at camera or parents

desire_motivation_analysis.reasoning_chain: Subject initiates interaction with questions about 'numbers' and 'record company'. Her persistence despite vague answers indicates a strong desire to resolve epistemic uncertainty regarding their financial safety.

supporting_evidence.description: Intense staring, eyebrows raised in demand for answer.
Blocking the doorway/standing over the seated male.

alternative_interpretations.reasoning: She may be seeking to establish control rather than just information.
alternative_interpretations.why_not_primary: The content of the questions is specific to financial survival (Maslow Safety), making information seeking the more parsimonious root cause.

desire_motivation_analysis.reasoning_chain: Subject uses minimization ('not great', 'trickled in') and physical barriers (desk) to create distance. He explicitly states he doesn't want a 'nasty fight', indicating a desire to escape the aversive social interaction.

supporting_evidence.description: Leaning back in chair, asking to talk 'the way the therapist told us'.

desire_motivation_analysis.reasoning_chain: When the female compares him to 'Garfunkel' (perceived as the lesser partner), his arousal spikes. He launches into a defense of his autonomy and value, indicating a shift from safety (avoiding fight) to esteem (defending his worth).

supporting_evidence.description: Mouth open, shouting, leaning forward aggressively.
Pointing finger to emphasize his point about 'Simon controlling him'.

trigger_event.description: Male admits to giving daughter antibiotics without telling her.

behavioral_markers.description: Expression shifts from anger/shock to confusion and sadness.
Shoulders drop, head tilts, voice becomes quieter.

desire_transitions.visual_marker_of_change: The moment she stops gesturing aggressively, stares blankly, and asks 'What are we even doing?'
desire_transitions.psychological_interpretation: The accumulation of lies overwhelms the specific inquiry about finances, triggering a higher-level existential evaluation of the relationship (Belonging needs).

behavioral_markers.description: Looks away from partner toward the door.
Turns and walks out of the room.

desire_transitions.visual_marker_of_change: The moment she turns her back and says 'I don't want to have a party here.'
desire_transitions.psychological_interpretation: Emotional exhaustion leads to a desire to avoid the social performance required by the upcoming party (Avoidance motivation).

behavioral_sequence.behavior_description: Rapid hand gestures, widening eyes, leaning forward while explaining why he lies.
behavioral_sequence.relevance_to_desire: Indicates a shift from passive avoidance to active defense of his behavior (Esteem/Safety).

behavioral_sequence.behavior_description: Stands in doorway, rigid posture, blocking the view to the outside, shouting about deposits.

key_segments_for_qa.psychological_significance: Demonstrates a complex projection of self-esteem issues onto a pop culture analogy. The male character reveals deep-seated insecurity about his status in the relationship.
Shows a clear conflict of desires: Female wants emotional relief (cancel), Male wants resource preservation (don't lose deposit).

inter_character_dynamics.mutual_influence: Negative feedback loop: Female's pursuit/interrogation triggers Male's avoidance/lying, which triggers further interrogation.

key_interaction_moments.description: Female calls Male a 'lying shitbag', causing Male to break the 'therapy rules' frame.
Male claims Female turns him into 'Garfunkel', explicitly blaming her for his lack of agency.

annotation_metadata.annotation_notes: The child character serves as a background element; their lack of reaction to the parents' shouting suggests habituation to conflict.
